entities.name: All-Consuming Oni of Chaos
entities.description: The mightiest oni on Kamigawa, embodying chaos, decay, hunger and destruction, a counterpart to O-Kagachi.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Kami embodying the barrier between the mortal and spirit world, order and preservation.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre shaman, the All-Consuming's most devout worshipper, who later consumed it.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Keeper of Minamo who repelled and banished the oni and transported Hidetsugu.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: A disk left in Minamo by Toshi Umezawa; repelled the All-Consuming.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Lord whose spectral warriors fought the All-Consuming's jaws.

entities.name: Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
entities.description: Embody Kamigawa's order, with Hidetsugu presumed as chaos counterpart.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of the oni and kami.

events.summary: Hidetsugu attacks Minamo and summons the All-Consuming, which feeds on the academics and their knowledge.
events.quote: The oni fed on the living and dead academics

events.summary: The All-Consuming tries to claim That Which Was Taken but is repelled and banished by Toshi.
events.quote: was repelled by the disk itself and then banished from the room by Toshi

events.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming in half; it flees and disappears.
events.quote: O-Kagachi almost effortlessly tore him in half and swallowed the torn part

events.summary: Enraged, Hidetsugu has Toshi transport him to the oni's honden and later consumes the All-Consuming into a new creature.
events.quote: Hidetsugu somehow consumed the All-Consuming into a new flesh-and-spirit creature

relations.quote: The oni's most devout worshipper was the ogre shaman Hidetsugu

relations.note: chaos counterpart; challenged and attacked it
relations.quote: He challenged and attacked the Great Serpent
